issue.title: `helm rollback` should not run patch logic as `--force` flag is not given (default behaviour)

labels.name: v4.x
labels.description: Issues and Pull Requests related to the major version v4

issue.body:
<!-- If you need help or think you have found a bug, please help us with your issue by entering the following information (otherwise you can delete this text): -->

Output of `helm version`: 
```
version.BuildInfo{Version:"v3.2.4", GitCommit:"0ad800ef43d3b826f31a5ad8dfbb4fe05d143688", GitTreeState:"dirty", GoVersion:"go1.14.3"}
```

Output of `kubectl version`: 
```

Server Version: version.Info{Major:"1", Minor:"18", GitVersion:"v1.18.2", GitCommit:"52c56ce7a8272c798dbc29846288d7cd9fbae032", GitTreeState:"clean", BuildDate:"2020-04-16T11:48:36Z", GoVersion:"go1.13.9", Compiler:"gc", Platform:"linux/amd64"}
```

Cloud Provider/Platform (AKS, GKE, Minikube etc.): 

---

**Case**

`helm rollback` hits the patch logic and gives an error:

```
Rollback "emer-admin" failed: cannot patch "emer-admin" with kind Deployment: The order in patch list: [map[hostnames:[idea0101.mongodb] ip:10.153.44.147] map[hostnames:[noclickcpc0101.mongodb] ip:10.153.44.147] map[hostnames:[cpc0101.mongodb] ip:10.153.44.147] map[hostnames:[idea0102.mongodb] ip:10.153.52.224] map[hostnames:[noclickcpc0102.mongodb] ip:10.153.52.224] map[hostnames:[cpc0102.mongodb] ip:10.153.52.224] map[hostnames:[noclickcpc0103.mongodb] ip:10.153.53.139] map[hostnames:[idea0103.mongodb] ip:10.153.53.139] map[hostnames:[cpc0103.mongodb] ip:10.153.53.139] map[hostnames:[querykey0103.mongodb] ip:10.153.52.63] map[hostnames:[cpc0201.mongodb] ip:10.153.52.63] map[hostnames:[noclickcpc0201.mongodb] ip:10.153.52.63] map[hostnames:[idea0201.mongodb] ip:10.153.52.63] map[hostnames:[cpc0202.mongodb] ip:10.153.58.52] map[hostnames:[noclickcpc0202.mongodb] ip:10.153.58.52] map[hostnames:[idea0202.mongodb] ip:10.153.58.52] map[hostnames:[cpc0203.mongodb] ip:10.153.60.75] map[hostnames:[idea0203.mongodb] ip:10.153.60.75] map[hostnames:[noclickcpc0203.mongodb] ip:10.153.60.75] map[hostnames:[cpc0301.mongodb] ip:10.144.122.209] map[hostnames:[galaxywirelesslog01.mongodb] ip:10.144.122.209] map[hostnames:[noclickcpc0301.mongodb] ip:10.144.122.209] map[hostnames:[idea0301.mongodb] ip:10.144.122.209] map[hostnames:[galaxywirelesslog02.mongodb] ip:10.144.125.225] map[hostnames:[cpc0302.mongodb] ip:10.144.125.225] map[hostnames:[noclickcpc0302.mongodb] ip:10.144.125.225] map[hostnames:
```

**Analysis**

 As a default behaviour, `--force` flag is not set for `helm rollback`, which means `r.Force` value is `false`, and this will finally run `patch, patchType, err := createPatch(target, currentObj)`, diff among current release manifest, target release manifest and current manifest from k8s, then make a patch.

https://github.com/helm/helm/blob/e31818f2efd3e1e0867d9c189507c25c8102264a/pkg/action/rollback.go#L162

https://github.com/helm/helm/blob/e31818f2efd3e1e0867d9c189507c25c8102264a/pkg/kube/client.go#L204

https://github.com/helm/helm/blob/e31818f2efd3e1e0867d9c189507c25c8102264a/pkg/kube/client.go#L414-L453

I doubt this rationality, in my understanding, `rollback` means that going back to the given version, replacing the resources with totally the target release manifest rather than making a patch.
